stable.headline: Depth of field, a Visible switch and 42 fixes
notes: Photo mode has depth of field: Alt+click a point to focus on it.
Edit mesh has a Visible switch: off, a box or the Brush also takes back sides and hidden parts.
The status pills beside the camera pill slide in and out.
A merge keeps each part's own material, and a merged model keeps its colours.
Mirrored parts stay the right way out through Bake transforms and the booleans.
A damaged STEP file says what is wrong, and failed conversions leave nothing behind.
The app does no work while nothing happens, and tooltips are one short line.
